cues: Shake with acidified potassium iodide: iodine is freed, blue with starch.
Or add iron two sulphate and thiocyanate: the iron is oxidised, and you get a blood red colour.
Prevent them by storing ether in dark bottles over sodium wire, and never distil ether to dryness.
text: Peroxides are detected two ways. Shake with acidified potassium iodide: iodine is freed, blue with starch. Or add iron two sulphate and thiocyanate: the iron is oxidised, and you get a blood red colour. Prevent them by storing ether in dark bottles over sodium wire, and never distil ether to dryness.
